steps.title: Interaction Diagram by Strain Compatibility
steps.formula:
For each neutral axis depth c:
  a = β₁ c, concrete force from the circular segment area
  bar strain εs = 0.003 (c − di)/c,  fs clamped to ±fy
  bars inside the block lose 0.85 f'c of displaced concrete
  Pn = ΣF,   Mn = ΣF·y
steps.sub:
The compression zone is a circular segment of depth a:
  θ = 2 arccos((R − a)/R)
  area = R²(θ − sin θ)/2
  centroid = 4R sin³(θ/2) / [3(θ − sin θ)]

221 neutral axis positions are evaluated from c = 2.5D down to zero.

pDeltaCheck.headline: θmax = 0.10347 vs limit 0.0909 — UNSTABLE — REDESIGN REQUIRED

steps.title: Design Storey Drift Δ
steps.formula:
δx = Cd · δxe / I
Δi = δx(i) − δx(i−1)        (BNBC Eq 6.2.44)
steps.sub:
Cd = 5.50,  I = 1.00
Amplified displacements are differenced level by level from the base up.

steps.title: Stability Coefficient θ
steps.formula: θ = Px · Δ / (Vx · hsx · Cd)        (BNBC Eq 6.2.45)
steps.sub:
Px is the total gravity load at and above the level.
Vx is the seismic shear acting in the storey.
hsx is the storey height.

steps.title: Stability Limit θmax
steps.formula: θmax = 0.5 / (β · Cd)   and   θmax ≤ 0.25        (BNBC Eq 6.2.46)

steps.title: Verdict
steps.formula:
θ ≤ 0.10          → P-Δ may be neglected
0.10 < θ ≤ θmax → P-Δ must be included in the analysis
θ > θmax        → structure is unstable, stiffen and reanalyse

warnings: θmax = 0.1035 exceeds the limit 0.0909. The structure is potentially unstable and must be stiffened.
